learning_objective: Child handles transition by politely negotiating a 5-minute buffer, then confirms the agreement.

curriculum.module: Managing Transitions and Screen Time Routines
target_rules: Do not ignore or yell when asked to stop an activity
If more time is needed, ask politely with a specific small duration
When the parent sets a condition, make a clear promise

scenario: Appa enters the living room at 7:00 PM (study time) and asks you to turn off the television.

initial_prompt.tanglish: Kanna, TV off pannuva? Study time achu.
initial_prompt.tamil: கண்ணா, டிவி ஆஃப் பண்ணுவா? ஸ்டடி டைம் ஆச்சு.
initial_prompt.english: Dear, will you turn off the TV? It's study time.

prompt.tanglish: Kanna, TV off pannuva? Study time achu.
prompt.tamil: கண்ணா, டிவி ஆஃப் பண்ணுவா? ஸ்டடி டைம் ஆச்சு.

feedback.hint: Ask Appa politely for a little more time, like 5 minutes.
feedback.gentle_correction: Try saying: 'Innum 5 minutes pa' (Just 5 more minutes, dad)

next_character_reply.tanglish: Seri, 5 minutes apram kandippa padikanum. Promise-ah?
next_character_reply.tamil: சரி, 5 நிமிஷம் அப்புறம் கண்டிப்பா படிக்கணும். பிராமிஸா?

prompt.tanglish: Seri, 5 minutes apram kandippa padikanum. Promise-ah?
prompt.tamil: சரி, 5 நிமிஷம் அப்புறம் கண்டிப்பா படிக்கணும். பிராமிஸா?

feedback.hint: Confirm your agreement by making a promise to Appa.
feedback.gentle_correction: A good way to agree is saying: 'Promise appa!'

completion.success_message: Great job! You politely asked for a little more time and made a promise.
